faq.q: Can you buy the AgiBot A2?
faq.a: Yes. The A2 Lite is listed on AgiBot's international store at $44,560; the A2 Ultra requires a quote.

faq.q: How much does the AgiBot A2 cost?
faq.a: The A2 Lite costs $44,560 on the official store, plus $500 to $3,000 shipping and local import duties. AgiBot does not publish a price for the A2 Ultra.

faq.q: Can you buy the AgiBot A2 in the US?
faq.a: Top3DShop lists the A2 as in stock with a 5 to 10 business day lead time, but you must request a quote for the price.

notes: The only public price is for the A2 Lite variant; the full A2 / A2 Ultra and wheeled A2-W have no published price. Chinese yuan prices circulating online were not traced to an official source and are excluded.
